name: Zamp
summary: Zamp is a managed sales tax service that combines address-level rate calculation, nexus monitoring, state registration and filing, with a dedicated team for notices. It says it prices each business as one figure with no per-transaction fees, and publishes no dollar amounts. A free plan covers a one-time nexus analysis.

facts.text: Zamp says it covers penalties and interest if a Zamp-managed calculation or filing causes them.
The US plan includes 80% early-warning alerts for nexus, automated state registrations and direct ACH remittance to states.
The US plus Canada plan adds GST, HST, PST and QST calculation, threshold monitoring, registration and return filing.
The free plan includes a 30-day rate-limited API sandbox, a one-time nexus analysis and a 30-minute expert consultation.
Zamp lists more than 30 integrations, including Shopify, NetSuite, QuickBooks Online, Xero, Stripe and Chargebee.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: One-time nexus analysis, taxability review and expert consultation
